core_obligations: Reduce to stalks (proof lines 20205-20209): the canonical map is checked on stalks at geometric points of Y; proper base change for modulo n coefficients reduces the statement to the case where Y is the spectrum of an algebraically closed field.

Apply the constant-factor computation (proof lines 20210-20215): over that base the statement is the pull-out lemma for a constant complex, applicable because the cohomological dimension of X is finite by the proper-morphism dimension bound.
proof_roadmap: Check the canonical map at stalks and reduce to the spectrum of an algebraically closed field by proper base change.
Use the constant-factor lemma, whose finite-cohomological-dimension hypothesis is supplied by the proper dimension bound.
difficulty_reason: The lemma is the projection formula for a proper morphism with coefficients in a torsion ring (statement lines 20192-20202). The proof (proof lines 20204-20215) checks the canonical map on stalks, reduces to an algebraically closed field base by proper base change for modulo n coefficients, and applies the constant-factor computation, the finite cohomological dimension being supplied by the proper dimension bound. H2: one reduction plus one application.
